title: Selected original common/name/reference targets
scope: Bounded immutable original targets for the selected rich/symbol/structural/TABLE-and-linked-record source frontier. Actual producer-backed name census/index, reference roles, hard-owner reverse links/cycle refusal, and independent STYLE/LTYPE schema guards. This is not complete field semantics, recursive closure, live/emitted proof, whole-document ownership or native CAD/kernel qualification.

sourceFrontier: Original TABLE parent and linked ATTRIB/SEQEND profiles
implementation.originalProviders: Pinned TableReferenceAudit provider index with actual original identity, structural, layout, entity/block and resource origins.
implementation.resolvedAliases: ASCII case variants plus escaped forms decoding to the same non-ASCII spelling; an unqualified non-ASCII collation alias cannot qualify solely through nameKey equality.
implementation.tableOwnerDisposition: OriginalTableOwner attests physical symbol-row membership in its exact original table control; it is not a table-control model/body or whole-document ownership certificate.
implementation.hardOwnershipCycles: Nonrecursive bounded Kahn traversal; affected hard-owner edges withhold qualification. Soft-pointer cycles keep original-target evidence and are not evaluated.
implementation.independentBudgets: Logical reserved-row, byte and work precharge/ceilings, including name-key/codec and graph workspace allowance. Not measured RSS.
implementation.plotStyleTargetKind: ACDBPLACEHOLDER; original producer and rooted plot-style-name dictionary/owner evidence remain unavailable.
